text: Abdul El-Sayed: Donald Trump and JD Vance can't seem to keep my name out their mouth. The tough part, of course, is that they don't really know what my name is. They certainly don't know how to say it. But it really doesn't matter because we're going to force them to learn how to say it with the word senator in front of it in November.
text_zh: 阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德：唐纳德·特朗普和JD·万斯似乎总是对我念念不忘。当然，困难之处在于他们并不真正知道我的名字。他们肯定不知道怎么读。但这真的没关系，因为在十一月，我们将强迫他们学会读我的名字，并在前面加上“参议员”这个头衔。

text: Abdul El-Sayed: We're paying $5,600 on average for a vanity tariff project that Donald Trump decided he wanted because Mark Carney is cooler than he is.
text_zh: 阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德：我们平均要为唐纳德·特朗普决定的一个虚荣关税项目支付5600美元，仅仅因为他觉得马克·卡尼比他更酷。

text: Abdul El-Sayed on Iran: War in Iran. Everybody could have told you this is a dumb idea. There was really only one person in the whole world who's had a 40-year project to get us to fight this war. He's a prime minister of another government. And he finally found the dumbass who was willing to do it.
text_zh: 阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德谈伊朗：伊朗战争。每个人都能告诉你这是一个愚蠢的想法。全世界真的只有一个人有长达40年的计划让我们去打这场战争。他是另一个政府的总理。他终于找到了那个愿意这么做的蠢货。

text: Marco Rubio: Trump doesn't want to see a crisis in the West Bank. We don't need that right now. Israel doesn't need that right now.
text_zh: 马可·卢比奥：特朗普不想看到西岸发生危机。我们现在不需要那个。以色列现在也不需要那个。

text: Q: One of the first decisions Trump took was to lift sanctions against the settlers. Rubio: Lifting sanctions does not mean he's a supporter of what he's seeing now on television, what he's reading about. He doesn't want to see what's happening now.
text_zh: 问：特朗普做出的首批决定之一是取消对定居者的制裁。卢比奥：取消制裁并不意味着他支持他现在在电视上看到的、在阅读到的内容。他不想看到现在发生的事情。

text: Q: I'd like to ask you about violence in the West Bank. My colleague was attacked there yesterday. Rubio: I saw that. We're very disturbed by those images and what we're seeing. We've asked the Israelis and continue to ask them to crack down on that stuff. Trump does not want to see friction or any crisis going on in the West Bank. It was an American reporter, maybe a photojournalist, who was caught behind where some of these groups came in and was beaten, and there was video of that. The whole thing was just disturbing. Not a good look.
text_zh: 问：我想问你关于西岸暴力事件的问题。我的同事昨天在那里遭到袭击。卢比奥：我看到了。我们对那些画面和我们所看到的情况感到非常不安。我们已经要求以色列人，并将继续要求他们严厉打击这类事情。特朗普不想看到西岸发生摩擦或任何危机。那是一名美国记者，可能是一名摄影记者，他被困在这些团体进入的地方后面并遭到殴打，而且有相关视频。整件事令人不安。看起来不太好。

text: Q: There's a criticism that we're basically giving Putin something for nothing. We're giving Putin these freebies. What's your response? Rubio: That diesel is going to be sold one way or the other. The diesel that Putin was going to sell, they were going to make it available to the global market one way or the other. The only difference is how much of it the United States was going to get.
text_zh: 问：有人批评说我们基本上是白白给了普京一些东西。我们给了普京这些免费赠品。你对此有何回应？卢比奥：那些柴油迟早会被卖掉。普京打算出售的柴油，无论如何都会进入全球市场。唯一的区别是美国能从中获得多少。

text: Q: On the sanctions waivers on Russia, Senator Ted Cruz today called it a big mistake that only serves to benefit Putin. I'm wondering what your response is to that. Rubio: The problem is these sanctions were not just sanctions on Russia. They include tariffs on a number of countries, India, for example, and others. And so I think the president wants to take the 60-day period of time to sort of analyze what imposing both sanctions and tariffs will mean to the global economy and even to the U.S. economy. I think when the bill was passed, one of the reasons the waivers were put in there was the understanding that they would need some period of time to study this, given all the different things that are going on in the world right now.
text_zh: 问：关于对俄罗斯的制裁豁免，参议员泰德·克鲁兹今天称这是一个大错误，只会让普京受益。我想知道你对此有何回应。卢比奥：问题在于这些制裁不仅仅是针对俄罗斯的制裁。它们还包括对许多国家（例如印度和其他国家）的关税。所以我认为总统希望利用这60天的时间来分析同时实施制裁和关税对全球经济甚至美国经济意味着什么。我认为当法案通过时，加入豁免条款的原因之一就是考虑到他们需要一段时间来研究这个问题，鉴于目前世界上正在发生的所有不同事情。

text: Marco Rubio on Ukraine: No one at the White House ordered anyone to slow down internet or slow down speed so that certain drones couldn't use it. But my understanding is it's back up and running.
text_zh: 马可·鲁比奥谈乌克兰：白宫没有人下令任何人减慢互联网速度或降低网速，以至于某些无人机无法使用它。但据我了解，它已经恢复正常运行了。

text: Marco Rubio: I know Ukraine wants access to Starshield. They do not have Starshield now. They've asked for access to it in order to conduct deep strikes inside of Russia.
text_zh: 马可·鲁比奥：我知道乌克兰想要使用“星盾”（Starshield）。他们现在还没有“星盾”。他们已经要求获得使用权，以便在俄罗斯境内进行纵深打击。

text: Q: Did the U.S. have anything to do with Starlink not working in Ukraine at the moment? Zelensky said it was deliberate. Rubio: I don't know what Zelensky said. I'm not sure Zelensky knows what he's talking about, but it wasn't deliberate. We had nothing to do with it. Nobody ordered Starlink's speed to be slowed down. It sort of happened. But my understanding is it's been restored. It's back to where it was before.
text_zh: 问：美国是否与目前乌克兰星链（Starlink）无法使用有关？泽连斯基说这是蓄意的。鲁比奥：我不知道泽连斯基说了什么。我不确定泽连斯基是否知道他在说什么，但这并非蓄意。我们与此无关。没有人下令降低星链的速度。这算是偶然发生的。但据我了解，它已经恢复了。它已经回到了之前的状态。

text: Marco Rubio: Starlink is a commercial product. It's regulated and handled as a commercial product. Starshield is a defense product, a military product. That is something that the United States military uses. It's not at this moment available to Ukraine, and that's under discussion right now, how they would want to use it.
text_zh: 马可·鲁比奥：星链是一种商业产品。它作为一种商业产品受到监管和处理。“星盾”是一种防御产品，一种军事产品。那是美国军方使用的东西。它目前不对乌克兰开放，目前正在讨论他们将如何使用它。

text: Violent anti-government protests rocked Albania’s capital, Tirana, for a fifth consecutive day on Saturday, as demonstrators hurled rocks, petrol bombs and fireworks at police, who responded with tear gas and water cannon. Protesters are demanding Prime Minister Edi Rama’s resignation over corruption allegations, with many calling for an end to the entire political establishment. Hundreds have been arrested or investigated, and dozens injured. Rama, who has ruled for 13 years, blamed the unrest on the opposition and unnamed foreign actors seeking to derail Albania’s EU ambitions. Meanwhile, corruption investigations involving senior officials and his associates are increasing pressure on his government.
text_zh: 周六，阿尔巴尼亚首都地拉那连续第五天爆发暴力反政府抗议活动，示威者向警察投掷石块、汽油弹和烟花，警方则以催泪瓦斯和高压水枪回击。抗议者要求总理埃迪·拉马因腐败指控辞职，许多人呼吁终结整个政治体制。数百人被捕或接受调查，数十人受伤。执政13年的拉马将动荡归咎于反对派和试图破坏阿尔巴尼亚欧盟雄心的未具名外国势力。与此同时，涉及高级官员及其同僚的腐败调查正给他的政府带来越来越大的压力。

As I told you when we first met in Kyiv four months into the war, you’re a modern-day Churchill fighting for freedom and democracy against an evil dictator. The free world must help you win. 👊 👊 - Piers Morgan tweet
text_zh: Nuno Felix 你可以尽情批评 @piersmorgan，我在许多问题上几乎不认同他的观点。然而，值得称赞的是，他捍卫了自由和将西方团结在一起的价值观。总统先生，这是我的荣幸。正如我在战争开始四个月后在基辅第一次见到您时所说的那样，您是一位现代的丘吉尔，正在为自由和民主而战，对抗邪恶的独裁者。自由世界必须帮助您获胜。👊 👊 - Piers Morgan 推文

text: WarMonitor RT @jamiedupree : Zelenskyy tells reporters that US restrictions are still in place on Starshield/Starlink for Ukraine's armed forces, complicating combat operations and drone defense Latest: ​Zelenskyy tells reporters over WhatsApp that restrictions on Ukraine's Starlink systems remain. Interceptor drones can't function, logistics and operations hobbled. The maximum speed is 161 kph; "exceeding this limit causes the Starlink connection to cut out completely, resulting in the loss of the drone." He says Ukraine has done tests to determine whether SpaceX is truly facing technical issues, as has been told Kyiv by the US side, or if this is a "deliberate operation... to restrict us, cut us off, and prevent us from defending ourselves and protecting our people, both at the front and among the civilian population." He says Ukraine "sent a couple of vehicles equipped with Starlink terminals into European Union territory." "They moved at speeds exceeding 180kph, and the Starlink systems worked perfectly. We have the relevant logs and evidence to prove this." He adds: "The conclusion is clear: the restrictions are in effect within Ukraine but do not apply within the European Union. In other words, this is a planned operation." - Christopher Miller tweet
text_zh: WarMonitor 转推 @jamiedupree：泽连斯基告诉记者，美国对乌克兰武装部队的 Starshield/Starlink（星盾/星链）限制仍然存在，这使作战行动和无人机防御变得复杂。最新消息：泽连斯基通过 WhatsApp 告诉记者，对乌克兰星链系统的限制依然存在。拦截无人机无法发挥作用，后勤和行动受阻。最高速度为 161 公里/小时；“超过此限制会导致星链连接完全中断，从而导致无人机丢失。”他说，乌克兰已经进行了测试，以确定 SpaceX 是否真的面临技术问题（正如美方告诉基辅的那样），或者这是否是一项“蓄意行动……旨在限制我们、切断我们的联系，并阻止我们保卫自己和保护我们的人民，无论是在前线还是在平民中。”他说乌克兰“派遣了几辆配备星链终端的车辆进入欧盟领土。”“它们的移动速度超过了 180 公里/小时，星链系统运行完美。我们有相关的日志和证据来证明这一点。”他补充说：“结论很明确：限制在乌克兰境内有效，但在欧盟境内不适用。换句话说，这是一项有计划的行动。” - Christopher Miller 推文
